title: System Monitoring
items: What is the Dashboard in the management GUI?
The home page displayed after login that gives a quick view of overall system condition and critical notifications
A replacement for the Performance page that shows all historical metrics
A CLI-only report generated by lssystem
A page that is only available through IBM Storage Insights
Dashboard 是登入 Management GUI 後的首頁，用來快速評估整體狀況並顯示需要立即處理的重大通知；官方明確說明它不取代 Performance 頁面或 System View。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch2 Dashboard
How much performance data does the Performance section of the Dashboard display?
Up to 5 minutes
Up to 1 hour
Up to 24 hours
Up to 7 days
Dashboard 的 Performance 區塊最多顯示 5 分鐘的資料，若要看更多 Metrics 需前往 Performance 頁面。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch2 Performance
How often is the performance graph on the Dashboard updated with new data?
Every 5 seconds
Every 1 second
Every 30 seconds
Every 5 minutes
Dashboard 的效能圖每 5 秒更新一次；每 5 分鐘是 IBM Storage Insights 收集統計資料的頻率，兩者不要混淆。
簡報 S3、S4；Concept Guide Ch2 Performance
Which two views can be selected in the Performance section of the Dashboard?
System and Node Comparison
Pool and Volume Group
Host and Host Cluster
Read and Write
Performance 區塊可切換 System (系統層級) 與 Node Comparison (各 Node 比較) 兩種檢視。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch2 Performance
Why does the Capacity section of the Dashboard have two different views?
One view is for FCM-based systems and another for non-FCM-based systems
One view is for standard pools and another for child pools
One view is for the GUI and another for the CLI
One view is for local storage and another for cloud storage
Capacity 區塊依系統是否以 FCM (FlashCore Module) 為基礎，分成兩種不同的檢視方式。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch2 Capacity
How does the System Health section of the Dashboard present component status?
Through tiles, where each tile contains one type of component
Through a single traffic-light icon for the whole system
Through a scrolling text event log only
Through a topology diagram of all ports
System Health 以 Tile 呈現，每個 Tile 只包含一種元件類型，但可包含多個同類元件，例如 Fibre Channel Tile 內含多個 FC Port。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch2 System Health tiles
In the System Health section, which tiles are displayed first?
Tiles with errors and warnings
Tiles sorted alphabetically
Tiles for the most recently added hardware
Tiles for logical components only
有錯誤與警告的 Tile 會排在最前面，讓需要注意的元件更醒目；健康的 Tile 則依日常使用的重要性排序。
Concept Guide Ch2 System Health tiles
Which three categories of tiles exist in the System Health section?
Hardware, Logical, and Connectivity components
Compute, Network, and Storage components
Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary components
Critical, Warning, and Informational components
System Health Tile 分為 Hardware Components、Logical Components 與 Connectivity Components 三大類。
Concept Guide Ch2 System Health tiles
In the Connectivity components section, what does a Configured status for IBM Storage Insights indicate?
The storage system is registered with IBM Storage Insights
A Data Collector is installed on every host
Storage Insights Pro license has expired
Call Home is disabled
Configured 表示儲存系統已註冊到 IBM Storage Insights，而 Call Home 欄位會顯示最後一次與 Storage Insights 同步的時間。
Concept Guide Ch2 System Health
Which CLI command provides the parameters used to calculate stored and available capacity?
lssystem
lsmdiskgrp
lsvdisk
lsnodecanister
使用 CLI 計算容量時，參數值取自 `lssystem` 指令的 total_mdisk_capacity、total_free_space 與 total_reclaimable_capacity。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring system-level capacity
What is the formula for total stored capacity?
total_mdisk_capacity - total_free_space - total_reclaimable_capacity
total_mdisk_capacity + total_free_space - total_reclaimable_capacity
total_free_space + total_reclaimable_capacity
total_mdisk_capacity - total_reclaimable_capacity + total_free_space
Total stored capacity = total_mdisk_capacity 減去 total_free_space，再減去 total_reclaimable_capacity。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch2
What is the formula for total available capacity?
total_free_space + total_reclaimable_capacity
total_mdisk_capacity - total_free_space
total_mdisk_capacity - total_reclaimable_capacity
total_free_space - total_reclaimable_capacity
Total available capacity = total_free_space 加上 total_reclaimable_capacity，因為 Reclaimable 容量最終會被回收再利用。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch2
What does the total_mdisk_capacity value in lssystem indicate?
The total usable capacity on the system
The total provisioned capacity presented to hosts
The capacity consumed by snapshots
The capacity of the boot drives
`lssystem` 的 total_mdisk_capacity 代表系統的總 Usable Capacity。
Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring system-level capacity
Why is reclaimable capacity subtracted from stored capacity and added to available capacity on the Dashboard?
Because it is not used by production data and will eventually be reclaimed for use
Because it is reserved for FlashCopy targets
Because it belongs to external storage systems
Because it is used as write cache
Reclaimable 容量不屬於正式資料，最終會被回收並可重新寫入，因此 Dashboard 會從 Stored 扣除並加到 Available，讓容量使用狀況更準確。
Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring capacity savings
For non-FCM systems, into which three categories is Usable Capacity divided in the donut graph?
Used Capacity, Available Capacity, and Total Capacity
Physical, Logical, and Provisioned Capacity
Written, Reserved, and Free Capacity
Compressed, Deduplicated, and Thin Capacity
非 FCM 系統的 Usable Capacity 以甜甜圈圖呈現，分為 Used、Available 與 Total Capacity 三類。
Concept Guide Ch2 Capacity
For FCM-based systems, what does Logical capacity indicate?
The total storage the system perceives as free or used, including optimizations such as deduplication, compression, and thin provisioning
Only the raw physical capacity of the FCM drives
Only the capacity written by snapshots
Only the capacity of external MDisks
FCM 系統的 Logical Capacity 是系統視為可用或已用的總量，已包含 Deduplication、壓縮與 Thin Provisioning 等最佳化效果。
Concept Guide Ch2 Capacity (FCM)
On an FCM-based system, which breakdown is shown in the Logical capacity section?
Written by hosts, written by snapshots, and logical reserved
Read IOPS, write IOPS, and latency
Tier0, Tier1, and nearline capacity
Child pools, parent pools, and provisioning groups
FCM 系統的 Logical Capacity 區塊會顯示 written by hosts、written by snapshots 與 logical reserved 的容量分佈。
Concept Guide Ch2 Capacity (FCM)
What happens if the system contains self-compressing drives and data reduction pools with thin volumes that are not compressed?
The system cannot determine accurate used usable capacity, and the Dashboard shows a message instead of capacity information
The system automatically enables compression on all volumes
The data reduction pools go offline immediately
Deduplication is disabled across the system
此 Configuration 下系統無法判斷準確的已用容量，可能過度 Provisioning 而失去寫入能力，Dashboard 的 Usable Capacity 區塊會改顯示訊息。
Concept Guide Ch2 Recovering from configuration that prevents accurate usable capacity reporting
How can you recover from a configuration that prevents accurate usable capacity reporting on systems with self-compressing drives?
Migrate thin and thin-deduplicated volumes to compressed volumes in data reduction pools, or to standard-provisioned volumes
Disable Easy Tier on all pools
Remove all self-compressing drives
Run the svctask chsystem -reportcapacity command
需將 Thin 與 Thin + Deduplicated Volume 移轉為 Data Reduction Pool 中啟用壓縮的 Volume，或改成 Standard-provisioned Volume 改用硬碟壓縮。
Concept Guide Ch2 Recovering from configuration
Which GUI action quickly converts the capacity savings method of a volume?
Modify Capacity Savings
Migrate to Another Pool
Expand Volume
Duplicate Volume
GUI 的 Modify Capacity Savings 會建立啟用新容量節省方式的 Mirrored Volume Copy，完成後自動刪除原始 Copy。
Concept Guide Ch2 Recovering from configuration
When converting a volume with 2 GB allocated capacity by using Modify Capacity Savings, what capacity must the pool have?
Another 2 GB to hold both the original and the copy during conversion
No extra capacity, because conversion is in place
Exactly 1 GB of free capacity
Four times the allocated capacity
轉換過程會建立 Volume Copy，因此 Pool 需額外準備與原始配置相同的容量 (此例為 2 GB)，轉換完成後原始 Copy 才會被刪除。
Concept Guide Ch2 Recovering from configuration
For external storage systems, what must administrators configure to avoid running out of usable capacity?
Out-of-space alerts on the external storage system at a defined threshold
Easy Tier balancing on every MDisk
A separate I/O group for external MDisks
Volume protection on every volume
外部儲存需在該儲存設備上設定 Out-of-space Alert 門檻；否則外部儲存可能被過度 Provisioning 而耗盡 Usable Capacity。
Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring external storage systems
What are provisioning groups?
Objects that identify whether external storage is shared across multiple pools
Groups of hosts that share the same volumes
Groups of volumes that share a snapshot policy
Groups of nodes in the same I/O group
Provisioning Group 是用來識別外部儲存是否被多個 Pool 共用的物件；可在 Pool 上按右鍵選 View Resources 查看。
Concept Guide Ch2 Configuration Scenario 2
When multiple pools contain different tiers of storage from multiple external systems, how does the system allocate capacity?
It attempts to allocate the entire usable capacity in the top tier rather than spreading extents across provisioning groups
It always spreads extents evenly across all tiers
It allocates only from the lowest tier
It refuses to create volumes in such pools
在 Scenario 3 (多層級外部儲存) 中，系統會優先配置最上層 Tier 的全部 Usable Capacity，而非平均分散，管理者需特別監控頂層容量。
Concept Guide Ch2 Configuration Scenario 3
When data reduction pools virtualize external storage that can run out of space, what is recommended?
Always enable compression when creating volumes in these pools
Always use fully allocated volumes
Disable unmap on all hosts
Use only child pools
Data Reduction Pool 虛擬化可能耗盡空間的外部儲存時，建立 Volume 一律要啟用壓縮，且外部儲存只能呈現實際 Usable Capacity。
Concept Guide Ch2 Configuration Scenario 4
For compressed arrays, at what percentage of usable capacity used is the first low-space warning (error code 1246) raised?
Compressed Array 使用達 90% 會觸發第一個低空間警告 (Event 020009、Error 1246)；96% 為 Critical、99% 為 1242、100% 為 1241。
Concept Guide Ch2 Table 1
Which error code indicates that a compressed array is out of usable capacity (100%)?
Compressed Array 100% 用盡時為 Error 1241 (Event 020012)；99% 剩 1% 時為 1242。
Concept Guide Ch2 Table 1
On which pool types is error 1246 NOT raised?
Easy Tier pools or data reduction pools
Standard pools with a single MDisk
Child pools
Pools with encryption enabled
官方說明 Error 1246 不會在 Easy Tier Pool 或 Data Reduction Pool 上觸發。
Concept Guide Ch2 Table 1 說明
Which capacity savings method removes unused allocated capacity rather than reducing the size of the data?
Thin provisioning
Compression
Deduplication
Self-compressing drives
Thin Provisioning 是移除未使用的配置容量；壓縮與 Deduplication 則是縮小資料本身來增加可用容量。
Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring capacity savings
Where must deduplicated volumes be created?
In data reduction pools
In standard pools
In child pools of standard pools
On external MDisks only
Deduplicated Volume 必須建立在 Data Reduction Pool；Standard Pool 不支援 Deduplication，現有 Volume 可移轉到 DRP 後再加上。
Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring capacity savings
If compressed volumes are configured in standard pools, what restriction applies?
You cannot create compressed volumes in data reduction pools within the same I/O group
You cannot create thin volumes in the same pool
You cannot use FlashCopy on those volumes
You cannot map those volumes to more than one host
若 Standard Pool 已有壓縮 Volume，同一個 I/O Group 內就不能在 Data Reduction Pool 建立壓縮 Volume。
Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring capacity savings
How is thin-provisioning savings calculated in the management GUI?
All written capacity is subtracted from all provisioned capacity
All free capacity is subtracted from MDisk capacity
Compressed capacity is divided by written capacity
Reclaimable capacity is added to used capacity
Thin Provisioning 節省量 = 全部 Provisioned 容量減去全部 Written 容量，代表已分配給 Host 但尚未實際存資料的容量。
Concept Guide Ch2 Monitoring capacity savings
On systems that support only standard pools built on FlashCore module based arrays, what is the best practice for volumes?
Set the volumes to be fully allocated
Set all volumes to thin-provisioned and deduplicated
Set all volumes to compressed
Use only image-mode volumes
只支援建立在 FCM Array 上之 Standard Pool 的系統，最佳實務是將 Volume 設為 Fully Allocated，壓縮交由 FCM 硬體處理。
Concept Guide Ch2 Note
Where do you access real-time performance statistics in the management GUI?
Monitoring > Performance
Settings > System
Pools > MDisks by Pools
Access > Users
即時效能統計從 Management GUI 的 Monitoring > Performance 進入。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch2 Performance statistics
Which comparison can help identify issues that need further evaluation by performance diagnostic tools?
Latency between volumes and MDisks
Number of hosts versus number of volumes
Firmware level versus code level
Pool name versus volume name
比較 Volume 與 MDisk 之間的 Latency 差異，可找出需要進一步以效能診斷工具分析的地方。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch2 Performance statistics
When might a System CPU (total) chart indicate that the system is overloaded?
When a data point is consistently above 95% utilization and I/O input is high
When a single spike reaches 80%
When CPU is below 10% for an hour
When compression utilization reaches 100% with low I/O
單一尖峰通常不代表效能問題；若持續高於 95% 且 I/O 輸入很高，系統可能過載，可能需要更多 Back-end 儲存。
Concept Guide Ch2 CPU Utilization
Which six metrics are displayed for both MDisks and Volumes in the Performance section?
Read IOPS, Write IOPS, Read bandwidth, Write bandwidth, Read latency, Write latency
CPU, memory, temperature, fan speed, power, voltage
Hit ratio, miss ratio, destage rate, prestage rate, queue depth, retries
Capacity, savings, reclaimable, free, used, total
MDisk 與 Volume 圖表都顯示 Read/Write IOPS、Read/Write Bandwidth 與 Read/Write Latency 六項 Metrics。
Concept Guide Ch2 MDisks and volumes
If volume write latency is equal to or greater than MDisk write latency, what might it suggest?
The drives might be overloaded and more drives might be necessary
The volume cache is working optimally
The host is using small I/O sizes
Replication is disabled
Volume Write Latency 通常因 Cache 而低於 MDisk；若相等或更高，可能代表硬碟過載，需要增加硬碟。
Concept Guide Ch2 MDisks and volumes
How does the management GUI display latency values below 1.000 millisecond?
In microseconds
In milliseconds with three decimal places
In nanoseconds
They are not displayed
GUI 以 1.000 毫秒為界，低於此值以微秒顯示，高於則以毫秒顯示；CLI 則一律以微秒顯示。
Concept Guide Ch2 Note
How can you determine the average transfer size of the workload?
Divide MBps by IOPS for read and write operations
Multiply IOPS by latency
Divide latency by bandwidth
Subtract write IOPS from read IOPS
將讀寫的 MBps 除以對應的 IOPS，即可得到平均傳輸大小，可用於驗證與預測硬碟 Configuration。
Concept Guide Ch2 MDisks and volumes
Which statistics file contains data for volumes and volume copies?
Nv_stats
Nm_stats
Ng_stats
Nn_stats
Nv_stats 為 Volume 與 Volume Copy；Nm 為 MDisk、Ng 為 Volume Group、Nn 為 Node。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch2 Statistics collection
Which statistics file contains Ethernet port error statistics?
Ne_stats
Nh_stats
Nd_stats
Nn_stats
Ethernet Port 錯誤統計寫在 Ne_stats，依實體 Ethernet Port 收集，並累計至計數器重設為止。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch2 Statistics collection
In which directory are statistics files written on the node?
/dumps/iostats/
/var/log/stats/
/home/admin/iostats/
/dumps/elogs/
統計檔存放在 Node 的 /dumps/iostats/ 目錄。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch2 Statistics collection
What happens when the 17th statistics file of the same type is created on a node?
The oldest file for the node is overwritten
Collection stops until files are deleted
All 16 files are archived to the config node
An error event is logged and the file is discarded
每種統計檔在 Node 上最多 16 個，產生第 17 個時會覆寫最舊的檔案。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch2 Statistics collection
What do Fabric Performance Impact Notifications (FPINs) provide?
Information about Fibre Channel fabric conditions that can affect host I/O performance
Notifications about expiring licenses
Alerts for low pool capacity
Warnings about NVMe namespace changes
FPIN 提供會影響 Host I/O 效能的 Fibre Channel Fabric 狀況，系統搭配 Remote Port 統計等 Metrics 找出並 Isolation Host 連線問題。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch2 FPIN-based monitoring
For which host ports are FPIN statistics NOT collected?
NVMe host ports
SCSI Fibre Channel ports on remote hosts
Ports on Brocade switches
Ports with link integrity issues
FPIN 統計只收集遠端 Host 的 SCSI Fibre Channel Port，NVMe Host Port 不收集。
Concept Guide Ch2 FPIN Note
How often does IBM Storage Insights collect volume compression and cyber resiliency statistics?
Every 5 minutes
Every 5 seconds
Every hour
Once per day
IBM Storage Insights 每 5 分鐘收集 Volume 的壓縮與 Cyber Resiliency 統計，協助偵測可能的勒索軟體攻擊。
簡報 S3、S8
How often should a full preventive monitoring check be completed at minimum?
At least every 6 months
At least every 5 years
Only after a hardware failure
Every hour
預防性監控部分工作可每日或每週進行，但完整檢查至少每 6 個月一次，包含環境、纜線、LED 與 GUI System Health。
簡報 S9
During preventive monitoring, what is the minimum bend radius for fiber optic cables?
3 inches
1 inch
6 inches
12 inches
光纖彎曲半徑不得小於 3 inches，且未使用的光纖 Port 需裝上 Wrap Plug。
簡報 S9
According to troubleshooting best practices, how should you power off the system?
Use the power management function in the management GUI
Pull the power cables from each node canister
Remove the node canisters one by one
Turn off the PDUs in the rack
關閉系統應使用 Management GUI 的電源功能；只有在 Service Action 指示時才可關閉或移除 Node Canister。
簡報 S10 (Troubleshooting Guide)
